summary.headline: Venus, Mars, and Mercury Aspects
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of the trine and sextile of Venus with Mars, followed by Mercury with Mars: war, sedition, marriages, pleasure, weather, disease, agriculture, trade, childbirth, news, bureaucracy, weapons, and alchemy.
